Thermaltake Toughpower Grand 750W Platinum From Thermaltake’s new “Toughpower” line of high-end PC power supply units, the Toughpower Grand Platinum launched with a practical, fully modular design. It’s also powerful at 650-1200W. Its sleek look with a classy black finish makes a bold statement. Being 80 PLUS Platinum certified, users not only get a guaranteed eco-friendly PSU, but also a smaller electricity bill. The Toughpower Grand models are suited for gaming and PC enthusiasts, powering multi-core processors in combination with multi-GPU configurations.  Ultra Quiet Fan With a 140mm fan built-in, Toughpower Grand 750W Platinum comes with a noise level of less than 20dB during normal operating levels to provide silent cooling for your PC.80PLUS Platinum Certified and Kaby Lake-Ready Deliver up to 89%-92% efficiency at any load to prolong the life of the battery. In addition, the Toughpower Grand Series is already prepared for Intel’s new, Seventh-generation Kaby Lake processor to achieve maximum energy savings.  Fully Modular Cable Design The fully modular cabling design makes installation easy. It allows the user to use only the cables they need, resulting in improved airflow and reduced system clutter. 100% High Quality Japanese Capacitors Japanese capacitors provide superb performance and reliability. Flat Modular Cables Toughpower Grand Series adopts flat modular cables to not only eliminate cable clutter within the system, but also to take up less space for better airflow.
